title: Transformer attention block diagram
alt: Technical block diagram showing input embedding, positional encoding, multi-head attention, normalization, feed-forward layers, and output flow in a transformer block.
caption: A transformer attention-block schematic; use it as an architectural map, not as a complete picture of a current AI product.
teachingUse: Gives students one inspectable architectural object when the chapter distinguishes language-model mechanisms from a simple autocomplete analogy.
